COD.rationale: Content (color and coordinates), explicit presentation (enumerated positions) and a separate origin/status field co-occur for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No attention/allocation or processing-condition statement explicitly linked to the identified contents' presentation/access.

C.rationale: Explicit identification of content (colors 'red'/'blue') together with positional attributes are listed.

D.rationale: Origin/metadata fields distinguish the record/status of the listed content from the simple position listing.

O.rationale: Explicit enumeration of how content is presented (coordinate lists) indicates organization/presentation/access.
